name: xG24 Explorer Kit (XG24-EK2703A)
description: Compact EFR32MG24 (78 MHz Cortex-M33, 1.5 MB flash) wireless kit for BLE, Thread, Zigbee and Matter, with on-board J-Link, mikroBUS and Qwiic connectors and breakout pads.
notes: On-board SEGGER J-Link, virtual COM port and packet trace; supports Adafruit, MikroElektronika, Seeed and SparkFun add-on connectors (Qwiic). Two LEDs and two push buttons.
DigiKey lists $40.26, Symmetry $39.00, Arrow $36.18. Silicon Labs' page returns 403 to automated fetches. Board size and GPIO count are estimates.
